description: List billing documents — invoices, credit notes, overpayments — with totals, paid/pending amounts, due dates and status. Filter by member, company, location, document type, status, number and issue/due date (e.g. overdue invoices). OfficeRnD: GET /payments.

cursor_next.description: The cursorNext from the previous page. Omit for the first page.

cursor_prev.description: The cursorPrev from a page, to go one page back.

due_before.description: Only documents due before this date (ISO 8601 date-time, e.g. 2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z).

issued_before.description: Only documents issued before this date (ISO 8601 date-time, e.g. 2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z).

issued_from.description: Only documents issued at or after this date (ISO 8601 date-time, e.g. 2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z).

modified_since.description: Only items modified at or after this time (ISO 8601 date-time, e.g. 2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z).

status.description: One or more statuses, e.g. paid, pending.

name: officernd_list_payments
title: List invoices and payments
